definitions.gloss: third place; third rank; bronze medal position
definitions.explanation: The third position in a ranking, competition, or hierarchy. In sporting events, third place typically receives a bronze medal.

examples.japanese: {三位|さんい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入賞|にゅうしょう}→入賞：11670_nyuushou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{今季|こんき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦リーグ{戦|せん}→リーグ戦：08411_riigusen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{三位|さんい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
examples.english: They finished third in this season's league.

examples.japanese: ⟦オリンピック→オリンピック：09899_orinpikku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{三位|さんい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}り→入る：00494_hairu⟧、⟦{銅|どう}メダル→銅メダル：22344_doumedaru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{獲得|かくとく}→獲得：05624_kakutoku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{誇|ほこ}り→誇り：03623_hokori⟧だ。
examples.english: Placing third at the Olympics and winning a bronze medal is a great source of pride.

notes:
Part of the ordinal ranking series: ⟦{一位|いちい}→一位：08926_ichii⟧ (first), ⟦{二位|にい}→二位：27466_nii⟧ (second), {三位|さんい} (third), {四位|よんい} (fourth), etc. The counter ⟦{位|い}→〜位：00443_i⟧ is used for rankings and placings.

In historical contexts, {三位|さんみ} (read さんみ) refers to the third rank in the ancient court ranking system ({位階|いかい}), as in {従三位|じゅさんみ} (Junior Third Rank). The modern reading さんい is used for competitive rankings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {三位|さんい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to place third
- {三位|さんい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入賞|にゅうしょう}→入賞：11670_nyuushou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to win third place (formal)
- {三位|さんい}{決定戦|けっていせん}: third-place match; bronze medal match
- {三位|さんい}⟦{一体|いったい}→一体：01731_ittai⟧: the Trinity (Christian theology)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {三番|さんばん}: third (in a sequence) — for ordering, not competitive ranking
- {三等|さんとう}: third class; third grade — for quality/class distinctions
- ⟦{一位|いちい}→一位：08926_ichii⟧: first place — the top rank
